payload.title: Migrate mention gold to canonical keys and source names
payload.description:
Migrate mention gold onto canonical keys and promote the source token into the canonical source-name field.

Three surfaces, all of which must move together:

1. **Layer name** — all 29 packets use `annotations/pii_signals.yaml`; not one uses `mentions.yaml`. A rename, not a dual-write, since there is no split state to reconcile.
2. **Subject key prefix** — all 357 mention annotations use `pii:` keys, which reach the scorer only through a hard-coded exemption in `assertCanonicalSubjectKey` (`tests/benchmark/manifest.ts`) permitting `pii:` on the mentions layer. Separate from the `pii_signal:` migration in `normalizeSubjectKey`. If the removal milestone covers only the layer name, the exemption quietly survives.
3. **Source name** — 339 of 357 carry a `subject.name` holding the observed token (`pii:access_token`/`id_token`, `pii:user_identifier`/`sub`). Promote into the source-name field per the `subject.name` ruling.

Blocked on the `subject.name` ruling.
